figures.title: Four boundaries for reusable knowledge
figures.desc: The saved rule guides interpretation. The file screen checks wording. The tool read root limits accessible files. Human admission selects reviewed Knowledge.
figures.caption: Keep saved-rule loading, file screening, tool access, and human admission distinct.
figures.transcript: The saved instruction stays outside model read roots and loads before provider contact. The file screen checks selected source files for fixed patterns. The tool reads only Sources during ingest or frozen Knowledge during retrieval. A human prepares and reviews Knowledge before freezing.

figures.title: Build, freeze, retrieve, improve
figures.desc: Read the sources once. Review proposals into Knowledge. Freeze admitted content. Retrieve in a fresh session. Repair a substantive weakness and repeat with a new revision.
figures.caption: A new cold run uses reviewed Knowledge and the saved rule, without raw sources or earlier chat.
figures.transcript: Sources produce Draft proposals. A human checks the evidence, prepares Knowledge, links existing notes, and records admission. Freeze copies MOC and reviewed Knowledge only. A fresh cold run reads that snapshot. Audit one substantive weakness, edit and review every changed note, freeze a new revision, and retrieve again while preserving the earlier snapshot.
